title: The easiest way to expose your Pod without a load balancer
caption: How NodePort opens access to your Kubernetes cluster. What port range does your team use?

scenes.vo: How do you reach a Pod from outside your cluster without a pricey cloud load balancer? Meet NodePort.
scenes.heading: NODEPORT

scenes.vo: NodePort opens one dedicated port on every single worker node, automatically forwarding incoming traffic straight to your Pod.
scenes.heading: TRAFFIC FLOW

scenes.vo: Think of it like an apartment intercom code that rings your specific flat from any entrance door.
scenes.heading: INTERCOM CODE
scenes.line: Rings your flat from any entrance door

scenes.vo: Because that port opens everywhere, hitting any node IP routes traffic forward, even if that node hosts no Pod.
scenes.heading: OPEN EVERYWHERE

scenes.vo: You can expose your deployment with one command, picking a port between thirty thousand and thirty-two thousand.
scenes.heading: KUBECTL TRICK

scenes.vo: So: fixed port range, opens across every node, direct external access. Follow for Kubernetes made simple.
scenes.heading: NODEPORT
